svg.title: Taurus
svg.desc: The app mark, and the source every generated icon comes from: the T on its rounded square. Not a second drawing of it — this is the Logo in src/components/icons.tsx on the same 32-unit grid, with the same radius, stroke weight and round caps. Only the colours differ, because they are resolved rather than named: Finder and Explorer do not know what var(--accent) means, so the dark theme's cyan and ink are written out. Regenerate the set with `pnpm tauri icon app-icon.svg`.
